evidence.quote:
Surely the
girl has not been kidnapped.
“You do not think I ought to go to the police?”

adjudications.reason: In the revision, 'The doctor hesitated' is followed at once by an unprompted police question. The kidnapping fear that motivates it in the source is gone. One short restored sentence fixes the chain. The advertising suggestion still works without the nurse question, so only the motive is restored.

evidence.quote: “My dear young lady, I can do nothing more, I fear.
His words gave Tuppence an extraordinarily desolate feeling.

adjudications.reason: Partly confirmed. 'His words gave Tuppence an extraordinarily desolate feeling' now points only at 'To Scotland'. The explicit abandonment that Tuppence later questions ('not abandoned the case') is missing. Restoring 'I can do nothing more, I fear' fixes both problems. The head-shake irony still largely survives, because the shake answers her 'And--Tommy?'. The 'Letters will always be forwarded' line is not needed because the handshake already implies farewell.

evidence.quote: Was there really nothing? If he could make a reservation, so could she.
I wonder if he did find anything in that safe----

adjudications.reason: Her recall of Julius's pause at the safe and her deliberate withholding both remain explicit. Her later musing about the safe also survives. Suspicion stays shared, so this is a legitimate compression.

evidence.quote: Say the word, and we’ll run round right away to some high-class jeweller, and fix up the ring business.

adjudications.reason: The businesslike frankness is still there ('What about me?', 'Sure thing', the jeweller and ring). So are the refusal, 'Because of Beresford?' / 'No, no, no!', 'It's no use' and the leave-it-till-tomorrow beat. The extra lines are an acceptable tradeoff under the word budget.

evidence.quote: “Not got a sort of kindly feeling for one another?”

adjudications.reason: Partly confirmed. 'Certainly not' answering 'What about it?' is a real turn-taking glitch, and it is repaired with the source question. The 'business instinct' reply still answers 'That's frank, isn't it?' adequately, so it is left alone.

remaining_concerns: The net reduction is estimated at about 35 words, short of the 48 target. Further cuts would start removing protected-adjacent voice or essential beats, such as Hall's dithering, the nose-blowing beat or the hesitation in the money creed.
